results.title: Lily's Ritual
results.overview: Four friends travel to an isolated house to perform a witchcraft ritual.

results.title: Threshold
results.overview: THRESHOLD is the story of Olympic gold medalist and most decorated American cross-country skier ever, Jessie Diggins, and the struggle behind her smile– a painful fight with an eating disorder at the peak of her career.

results.title: Y-Concert
results.overview: The evening stages from Y-Concert by YeaH1, the 10-hour music festival for 55 artists.

results.title: Mommy Blue
results.overview: The story revolves around Krisztina, an art teacher who is progressively losing her sight as a complication of diabetes. It engenders a crisis, not only in her own life but also in that of her son. Máté must contend with the state of his mother’s health immediately following the birth of his first child. He does his best to help Krisztina, but his life is gradually torn between his increasingly clingy mother and his own little family. Krisztina, meanwhile, fears being alone in the dark…

results.title: King of Dope
results.overview: Dawid is an ordinary boy who builds a legal drug empire and becomes an overnight millionaire. Sudden fame, beautiful women, fast cars, endless partying, confrontations with gangsters, and dealings at the highest levels of power—this is his new world, where the line between legal and illegal is as thin as the line in a mirror. When an ethical cop arrives, everything is at stake. Will Dawid be able to stop him before it's too late? Will love save him from ultimate collapse?

results.title: Dominykas the Horse's Journey to the Stars
results.original_title: Dominykas the Horse's Journey to the Stars
results.overview: This family-friendly story about love, unity, and life's wisdom follows the brave horse Dominykas, who embarks on a cosmic odyssey in search of a magical gemstone capable of saving his beloved Rugiagele from the freezing winter cold. Visiting the Moon, Mars, Venus, and other planets, Dominykas gains new friends along the way and together they discover the power of love, friendship, and courage-qualities essential for overcoming any challenge.

results.title: Flaccid
results.overview: A surreal feminist satire sees history’s greatest patriarchs - Adam, Genghis Khan, Henry VIII, and Napoleon - undone by Lilith and a mischievous Goddess of the void. Through rich tableaux, symbolic food rituals, and playful myth-making, the film exposes the fragility beneath dominance and reimagines softness as a radical force.

results.title: Aladdin
results.overview: A group of friends vacation on a lake front cabin and find Aladdin's ancient lamp which grants 3 terrible wishes.

results.title: Pesca
results.overview: In Panama, 12-year-old Clara goes fishing for “mahi-mahi“ dolphinfish with her father. As they venture further from the shore, the unease he stirs in her grows increasingly oppressive.

results.title: Let Us Through, Dear Ancestors
results.overview: 1617, Las Islas Filipinas. The Spanish friar, Father Enciso, the encomendero of one of the islands, rules with unrelenting toughness and an insatiable libido to tame the savages.

results.title: NJPW Best of the Super Junior 33 - Day 14 (Final)
results.original_title: NJPW Best of the Super Junior 33 - Day 14 (Final)
results.overview: The fourteenth and final night of Best of the Super Junior 33 took place on June 7, 2026 at Ota City General Gymnasium in Tokyo, Japan and was headlined by the final match to crown the tournament winner.

results.title: Supper
results.overview: A lonely man’s obsession with an online mukbang livestreamer leads to a tense confrontation with an unsuspecting dinner guest.

results.title: Cartografía
results.overview: An intuitive self-portrait and esoteric geographic exploration of the filmmaker's astrocartography line of Venus and Midheaven in Los Angeles, a prominent point in her birth chart for creativity and harmony.  With each version of herself comes a distinct relationship with the city and cinema, and each version shares an unavoidable fate: the passing of her grandmother.

results.title: Bruce Springsteen and the E Street Band: Land of Hope and Dreams American Tour (Philadelphia Freedom Cut): Part Two
results.original_title: Bruce Springsteen and the E Street Band: Land of Hope and Dreams American Tour (Philadelphia Freedom Cut): Part Two
results.overview: Bruce Springsteen and The E Street Band have released the second part of their Philadelphia Freedom Cut project, sharing official video of the next seven songs from their Land of Hope and Dreams American Tour finale: “The Promised Land,” “Two Hearts,” “Hungry Heart,” “Youngstown,” “Murder Incorporated,” “American Skin (41 Shots)” and “Long Walk Home.”

results.title: Pathetic Fallacy
results.overview: A grieving young widower seeks healing in a spiritual mountain town but encounters a bizarre murderer and demonic forest spirits who offer him the power to cheat death at a terrifying cost.

results.title: Stardom Cinderella Tournament 2026 ~Opening Round: Day 2~
results.overview: Cinderella Tournament 2026 ~Opening Round: Day 2~ was a professional wrestling event promoted by World Wonder Ring Stardom, held on March 7, 2026, at Chunichi Hall in Nagoya, Aichi, Japan. It primarily focused on first round matches for the company's annual single-elimination tournament.

results.title: Home Along da Riles: Da Reunion
results.original_title: Home Along da Riles: Da Reunion
results.overview: Years after Kevin Cosme's death, his children strive to uphold the values he taught them. Tensions arise when Bing announces her plan to marry her mysterious long-time boyfriend, prompting her brothers Bill, Bob, Baldo, and Estong to attempt to stop the wedding. Meanwhile, Azon, Kevin's widow, becomes saddened by the children's growing disunity and apparent abandonment of the values they were raised with, while imagining visions of Kevin as if he were still alive.

results.title: The Farm
results.overview: After the sudden loss of her parents, 12-year-old İrem moves in with her estranged grandmother on a semi-industrial dairy farm. As she witnesses the routine separation of newborn calves from their mothers, İrem becomes increasingly troubled by the quiet violence embedded in everyday practice to gain more milk. This unsettling realization leads her to make a small but radical decision: to free the pregnant cows from the farm, with the help of Halid, an orphan apprenticed to the farm’s veterinarian.

results.title: AEW All In 2026: London
results.overview: All In 2026, also promoted as All In London, was a professional wrestling pay-per-view produced by All Elite Wrestling (AEW) that took place on August 30, 2026, at Wembley Stadium in London, England. The event featured AEW Men's and Women's World Championship matches earned by the winners of the 2026 Owen Hart Foundation Tournament.

results.title: The Man in the Window
results.overview: A grieving widow grows suspicious of her mysterious new neighbor after local crimes occur. Despite her friend's support, the community dismisses her concerns, leaving her to uncover the unsettling truth alone.
